% Función: comprobar los nombres y las versiones con saltos de línea de TFM.
%
% Uso: prueba automatizada; no debes modificarlo para preparar tu documento.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{ifthen}
\newcommand{\myLanguage}{\TestLanguage}
\input{\TestConfigDirectory/degree-registry.tex}
\input{\TestConfigDirectory/institutions.tex}
\input{\TestConfigDirectory/layout-profiles.tex}
\input{\TestConfigDirectory/degrees.tex}

\makeatletter
\newcommand{\CheckValue}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  % Compara el texto; las pruebas de portadas comprueban las mayúsculas.
  \def\MakeUppercase##1{##1}%
  \protected@edef\actual{#1}%
  \protected@edef\expected{#2}%
  \protected@edef\actual{\actual}%
  \protected@edef\expected{\expected}%
  \ifx\actual\expected\else
    \PackageError{master-translations}{Unexpected value: \meaning\actual}{Expected \meaning\expected}%
  \fi
  \endgroup
}
\makeatother

\newcommand{\CheckMaster}[4]{%
  \DegreeRegistrySelect{#1}%
  \CheckValue{\myWorkType}{TFM}%
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\myLanguage}{english}}%
  {%
    \CheckValue{\myDegreefull}{#3}%
    \CheckValue{\myWorkTypeFull}{Master's Thesis}%
    \CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrapped}{#4}%
    \CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrappedUpcase}{\MakeUppercase{#4}}%
  }%
  {%
    \CheckValue{\myDegreefull}{#2}%
    \CheckValue{\myWorkTypeFull}{Trabajo Fin de Máster}%
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name-wrapped}}{}}%
      {\CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrapped}{#2}}%
      {\CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrapped}{\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name-wrapped}}}%
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name-wrapped-uppercase}}{}}%
      {\CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrappedUpcase}{\MakeUppercase{#2}}}%
      {\CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrappedUpcase}{\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name-wrapped-uppercase}}}%
  }%
  \typeout{PASS: master #1 / \myLanguage}%
}

\ExplSyntaxOn
\seq_map_inline:Nn \g_uah_degree_registry_ids_seq
  {
    \DegreeRegistrySelect{#1}
    \tl_set:Nx \l_tmpa_tl {\myWorkType}
    \str_if_eq:VnF \l_tmpa_tl {TFM}
      {
        \CheckValue{\myDegreefull}{\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name}}
        \tl_set:Nx \l_tmpa_tl {\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name-wrapped}}
        \tl_if_blank:VTF \l_tmpa_tl
          {\CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrapped}{\myDegreefull}}
          {\CheckValue{\myDegreefullwrapped}{\DegreeRegistryValue{degree-name-wrapped}}}
      }
  }
\ExplSyntaxOff
\typeout{PASS: non-TFM names unchanged}
